strings.zh: 健保：診察費 + 處方費，自付額幾百元。自費：依劑量月費 NT$ 1,500-3,500。差距主要在門診次數頻繁時健保較划算；但有些醫師偏好特定品牌，自費可選擇。
strings.en: Under NHI: consultation + prescription fees with copay around a few hundred NT$. Out-of-pocket: NT$ 1,500–3,500 per month depending on dose. NHI is more economical for frequent visits, but some physicians prefer specific brands available only out-of-pocket.

strings.zh: 復邁(Adalimumab)健保有條件給付：乾癬、乾癬性關節炎、類風濕性關節炎、僵直性脊椎炎、青少年型關節炎、克隆氏症、潰瘍性結腸炎、葡萄膜炎、化膿性汗腺炎(HS,2024 起)。每個適應症的劑量、給付條件都不同。
strings.en: Adalimumab (Humira) is conditionally covered by NHI for: psoriasis, psoriatic arthritis, rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, juvenile idiopathic arthritis, Crohn's disease, ulcerative colitis, uveitis, and hidradenitis suppurativa (since 2024). Dosing and coverage criteria vary per indication.

strings.en: Taiwanese Dermatological Association (TDA) consensus statements: acne (2024), atopic dermatitis (2020), rosacea (2022), psoriasis (2024), alopecia areata (2024), urticaria (2021), vitiligo (2024), hidradenitis suppurativa, TKI dermatologic toxicity (2024).
